decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed was heavily saturated with accessories like travel cases and charging cables, which made finding high-quality speakers difficult. I narrowed my consideration set to the most viable speakers across different price points, but found disqualifying flaws in each. The high-end Sony (prod_bluetooth_speakers_144) had poor reviews regarding its software and app connectivity. The Altec Lansing (prod_bluetooth_speakers_143) had alarming reports of the hardware melting and failing despite being marketed for outdoor use. The mid-range and budget options like the NOTABRICK (prod_bluetooth_speakers_168), Ortizan (prod_bluetooth_speakers_103), and comiso (prod_bluetooth_speakers_048) were better reviewed but still had consistent complaints about inconsistent pairing, harsh sound quality at high volumes, or battery life failing after a few months. Given the quality concerns on the premium units and the mediocre reliability of the budget options, I decided not to make a purchase.
